title: Jump Festa 2027 Teases Big Updates & Reveals With Packed Schedule
content: Shueisha’s about to show off some big updates from their many Shonen Jump franchises, and Jump Festa 2027 has dropped a packed lineup teasing all of the big things that might be revealed during the event.
author: ComicBook

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Is Now Easier to Stream Than Ever Ahead of Part 2
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle is now easier to stream thaner thanks to a big update while fans wait on the next major film. Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba kicked off a new film trilogy to adapt the massive Infinity Castle arc from Koyoharu Gotoge’s original manga.

title: 'Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen - Kashin-tan' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website of the Bleach: Sennen Kessen-hen - Kashin-tan ( Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity ) television anime announced an additional pair of cast on Monday. The anime series premiered on July 25 at 11.00 p.m. on TV Tokyo and its affiliates.

title: Topco Media Rebrands as Ankey AX, Expanding Webtoon IP Business Into AI
content: Topco Media, the Korean company behind the webtoon platform Toptoon, has changed its corporate name to Ankey AX Co., Ltd., as it expands beyond webtoon content into AI-powered services. The company approved the name change at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on September 10.
author: ANN

title: Musician Coda to Perform in New York City on November 8
content: Japanese musician Coda will perform as "Kazuso Oda & His NY Club Band" in New York City on November 8 at The Jazz Gallery, 1158 Broadway, 5th Floor, New York, NY 10001. Early bird tickets for the show are now on sale and general admission tickets will go on sale October 1.
author: ANN

title: One Piece Finally Locks In the Biggest Upgrade for Its Most Important Character
content: With the new chapters released, One Piece continues to dive deeper into the lore of the Elbaph arc, and as the fight grows even more intense and reaches its climax, the heroes are starting to prevail with new tricks up their sleeves.
author: ComicBook

title: Voice Actress Asami Yaguchi Dies at 47
content: Talent agency Kenyū Office announced on Monday that voice actress Asami Yaguchi died suddenly on Saturday. She was 47. A private funeral service with only close relatives in attendance is being held in accordance with the family's wishes.
author: ANN

title: Dungeon Friends Forever Manga Ends With 8th Volume
content: Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga physically and digitally, and describes the story: A charming fantasy rom-com about a human adventurer and his childhood friend, the dragon girl boss of a dungeon! Van the warrior and Ryuka the dragon have been friends since childhood.
author: ANN
